text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock E and Stock A after gains, then bought Stock E again at a much higher price; I should avoid selling solely for the satisfaction of realizing a profit and consider the longer-term plan.","I bought all five stocks in Period 7, including Stock E at a much higher price than my earlier sales, without evidence here that the timing was better; I should make purchases deliberately rather than react to having cash available.","After the account fell in Periods 9 and 10, I made no trades; that restraint can be useful, but I should review each holding on its current prospects instead of letting either losses or my reluctance to admit a mistake decide for me."]}
